The management appears more focused on marketing their “top results” than actually supporting every student. It feels like attention is given only to a selected few who can boost their image, while the rest are left to manage on their own.

When I personally approached them to raise these issues, the response was absolutely unacceptable. The person in charge (Chirag Sir) showed blatant arrogance and a completely dismissive attitude, casually telling me to just take a refund instead of addressing any of the concerns. There was zero accountability and no willingness to take responsibility for my ward’s studies. This kind of behaviour clearly shows how little they care about students once the fees are paid.

Overall, a very 💩 experience.
